title: XQ Super School — High School Redesign Platform
jpTitle: XQ Super School — 高校再設計プラットフォーム
organization: Emerson Collective (in partnership with Amplify Education)

summary.en: As Design Director, built XQSUPERSCHOOL.ORG as the central digital hub for Emerson Collective's nationwide high-school redesign competition. Designed the XQ Canvas Framework, a Business-Model-Canvas-inspired collaborative tool for teams to develop school visions, plus XQ Directory, a team-building feature for competition applicants.
summary.jp: 全米高校再設計コンペの中核サイトを、設計統括として構築した。共同編集の枠組み「XQ Canvas」と、チーム編成機能も作った。

product.en: The platform's real product wasn't the website — it was the XQ Canvas, a Business-Model-Canvas-style framework that gave scattered teams around the country a shared structure for developing a school redesign vision.
product.jp: 本当の成果物はサイトではなかった。ビジネスモデルキャンバスに倣った枠組み、XQ Canvas を作った。全米に散らばるチームに共通の型を与えた。

mine: Designed XQSUPERSCHOOL.ORG as the competition hub — information, resources and community features
Designed the XQ Canvas Framework, inspired by the Business Model Canvas, for iterative school-vision development
Designed XQ Directory, a team-building feature connecting individuals for team formation
Used motion design and storyboarding to make complex processes feel intuitive
Led experience strategy, UX/UI design, framework design and motion design
team: Amplify Education partnership: creative director, visual designer, business strategist, web developer, media strategist and project manager — credited on the page by role title, without individual task breakdown separate from Takao's

label.en: products: website, canvas framework, and directory

narrative.problem: The initiative needed a digital platform that could serve as the central hub — not just a website, but an ecosystem of tools that would enable diverse teams across the country to envision, design and submit innovative school models.

_notes: Engagement recorded as freelance based on roles.json's cie evidence list, which includes xq.
